en.headline: Hong Kong’s first five-year plan consultation closes with more than 16,000 submissions
en.dek: Secretary for Constitutional and Mainland Affairs Janice Tse said views generally supported focused alignment with national development and faster progress on the Northern Metropolis.
body: The two-month public consultation on Hong Kong’s inaugural five-year plan for economic and social development closed on Friday after receiving more than 16,000 submissions from members of the public and stakeholders.

Secretary for Constitutional and Mainland Affairs Janice Tse told reporters that artificial intelligence had been used to analyse the feedback. She said the views generally supported more focused integration into national development, including the “four centres and one hub” positioning, cultivation of emerging strategic industries and reinforcement of Hong Kong’s role as an international financial and innovation and technology hub.

Tse noted strong interest in accelerating development of the Northern Metropolis and the Loop Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Co-operation Zone, as well as livelihood concerns covering housing, healthcare, education and welfare. More than 100 consultation sessions were held during the period, about 30 of them led by Chief Executive John Lee.
The government aims to publish the five-year plan in September. Tse described the exercise as a milestone in public administration for the city.

zh.headline: 香港首份五年規劃公眾諮詢結束 收到逾1.6萬份意見
zh.dek: 政制及內地事務局局長謝小華表示，意見普遍支持聚焦對接國家戰略發展，並加快北部都會區建設，目標九月內發表規劃。
body: 香港首份經濟及社會發展五年規劃的公眾諮詢期周五結束，政府共收到逾一萬六千份來自不同界別市民及持份者的意見或建議。
政制及內地事務局局長謝小華會見傳媒時表示，當局利用人工智能整合及分析意見，意向普遍支持香港聚焦對接國家層面的戰略發展，包括推進「四中心一高地」、培育具策略價值的新興產業，以及着力建設國際創科中心和鞏固國際金融中心地位。
她指出，不少意見支持加快北部都會區發展及河套深港科技創新合作區建設，同時就房屋、醫療、教育及福利等民生範疇提出關注。諮詢期間共舉行逾一百場諮詢會，其中約三十場由行政長官李家超親自主持。
謝小華表示，政府會繼續整理及分析意見，目標在九月內發表第一個香港五年規劃，並形容是次諮詢為公共行政發展的里程碑。
